title: Mitayi Pico
purpose: Microcontroller development board: an RP2040 with flash, USB-C power and a 3.3 V regulator

source.title: Mitayi-Pico-D1 R0.6

source.quote: README.md: "All the design files of Mitayi-Pico are completely open-source and released under the MIT license." The purpose line is from its feature list: "RP2040", "USB-C for power and communication", "MIC5219 LDO with 3.3V, 500 mA output".
